Origin and meaning

Benjamin is a Hebrew name meaning “son of the right hand”.

About the name Benjamin

In the Bible, Benjamin was the youngest son of Jacob and Rachel.

As a gift or a tattoo

Because it means “son of the right hand”, a Benjamin calligraphy print makes a thoughtful gift for someone who loves the name or its meaning.
